verdict.rationale: Edge functions are a fair question for a cloud provider like Railway, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions edge functions or names any supported languages such as Python, Go, or Rust. Running applications closer to users and auto-detecting code settings are adjacent capabilities (regional app deployment and build auto-config), not language support for edge functions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write edge functions in languages other than JavaScript such as Python, Go, or Rust
